snippet.title: Creatures Like Us Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
KICKSTARTER PRELAUNCH 
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/circleastudios/creatures-like-us-be-gay-do-anarchy
STEAM WISHLIST
store.steampowered.com/app/3471580/Creatures_Like_Us
DISCORD COMMUNITY
discord.com/invite/8MrVWtyBKK

Creatures Like Us is a story-rich video game focusing on a group of friends as they navigate houselessness by squatting in derelict commercial buildings in an increasingly hostile political environment. The main themes of the game focus on anarchism, queer politics, systems change, mutual aid, and consent based decision making. Tonally it's equal parts ridiculous humour and social commentary.

Creatures Like Us combines a unique blend of simulation game play much like The Sims with a rich narrative and choices matter approach. The player must tend to the needs of their crew whilst completing objectives to make themselves a stable place to live. How well the player cares for the needs of the crew has a direct impact on the dialogue options available. Push them to say things that go against their feelings at the risk of triggering Burn Out. Will you band together to rally the wider community in the face of a shadowy landlord conspiracy, or will you simply try to survive the crumbling ruins of late stage capitalism?

#creatureslikeus #indiegame #lgbt  #queer #squatting #begaydoanarchy #anarchism #anarchy #simulationgame
